LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.1: Length

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Length. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-088.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 88]]

From your pupil's book (page 88)

MEASUREMENT LENGTH Week 8 Lesson 3 Measuring lengthin metres Activity 1 What is the length of the chalkboard?

Work to do Measure Objects Lengths in metres

Longer side of the classroom cupboard Shorter side of the classroom door Length of classroom window 3.

football field The length of the school garden 5.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-243.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 243]]

From your pupil's book (page 243)

MEASUREMENT LENGTH Week 6 Lesson 3 Adding Lengths in Metres Example Add the lengths

Longer length shorter length _________ + ___________ = Longer length longer length _________ + ___________ = Shorter length shorter length _________ + ___________ =

Work to do 1. The distance from grade 3A to grade 3B is 5 metres. The distance from grade 3B to the staffroom is 8 metres. What is the distance from grade 3A to the staffroom.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-245.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 245]]

From your pupil's book (page 245)

Week 6 Lesson 4 Subtracting lengths in metres

Example 1 John has a 5m rope. He gives Paul 4m of the rope. How many metres of rope was John left with? 5m – 4m = 1m

Example 2 Subtract 450m from 625m. Arrange as follows 625m - 450m 175 m 625m - 450m = 175m

1. A piece of timber is 27m long. 7m is cut from it. How long is the remaining timber? 2. The length of a classroom block is 87m. A worker painted 58m. How many metres remained?

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Length means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Length.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Length
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
